milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the pink carpet trail (centered at spawn-relative [3, 0, 4]) and face toward it. max_distance=10 is generous since the carpet is close to spawn but the player must actively look at it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the carpet.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the green bed (centered at spawn-relative [8, 0, 11]) and face toward it. max_distance=8 requires the player to walk from the carpet area into the bedroom zone. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate through the doorway in the dividing wall and get near the jungle stairs structure (centered at spawn-relative [15, 1, 10]) while facing toward it. max_distance=8 requires passing through the doorway. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the stairs.
